name: Stargate identity
work: Existing Go replacement is documented in the prior compatibility inventory. Verify pinned licensed ownership and account/session/profile/relationship interfaces; do not duplicate already-migrated identity from the username helper. No new repository access is implied by this plan.

name: Blade gateway and realtime entrypoint
work: Prove service-prefix rewriting, special discovery/federation aliases, health gating, websocket fanout and discovery/TLS against the authorized pinned gateway before changing public route claims.

name: DysonFS storage/media
work: Integrate permitted file/ACL/quota/object interfaces and migration semantics with synthetic storage. Existing Go storage does not remove media/native-library or quota dependency tests.

name: MetoerPush notifications/scheduling
work: Verify cache-envelope/event casing, JetStream versus in-process queue behavior, delivery/ack/retry and restart semantics. Do not rewrite Ring blindly or infer durable delivery from service existence.

name: Other backend repositories and unavailable systems
work: The root inventory is a scoped source map, not the entire organization. Reconcile licensed, pinned already-known backend ownership and explicitly authorized systems. SoSYS access denials, cancelled reads and missing permission remain genuine blockers; do not retry through another identity or route.

name: Clients
work: Use existing clients only as authorized compatibility consumers. Client rewrites, branding/assets and unrelated frontend work are outside this backend Go port; test route, session, pagination and event behavior without copying unlicensed artifacts.
